experiment_name: Hormuz fertilizer disruption → US nitrogen producer operating leverage

novelty_warning: Existing LSB IR releases in April and July 2026 and prior analyst research discussed Hormuz and US gas advantage. Not a claim to have found the theme first.

observed_facts_at_registration.claim: UN official warned on 2026-10-14 that non-activation of protected Hormuz fertilizer transit could worsen shortage and food risks; mechanism already active, not a newly invented conflict.
WTO July 2026 analysis recorded severe disruption to global fertilizer trade through Hormuz.

LSB Q2 2026 average netback UAN $433/short ton vs $308 Q2 2025; ammonia $658 vs $369; natural gas cost $2.96/MMBtu vs $3.50 Q2 2025; sales $168.1m and adjusted EBITDA $53.1m; Q2 included planned turnarounds.
observed_facts_at_registration.units_note: USD/short ton and USD/MMBtu are DIFFERENT units and gas cost is realized period cost.

observed_facts_at_registration.claim: Company schedules Q3 2026 results for Oct 28 after close and conference Oct 29. Q3 closes Sep 30 and cannot directly measure Oct 14 announcement effect.

Independent secondary weekly U.S. prices on Oct 15 reported UAN 32% $622.14/short ton (+11.6% weekly), ammonia $905.67/short ton (+11.1%), while urea fell 7.7%. Provider's regional retail/wholesale mixture must not be mistaken for LSB plant netback.
US Henry Hub natural gas spot price Oct 14 $3.22/MMBtu, from EIA as republished by YCharts; not directly comparable to company realized cost in Q2.
